# errors/from_progress_role_rejected_on_stateless — slice 4 deleted the
# {from_progress: <role>} discriminator; the cursor-namespace validator now
# catches templates that ref any cursor field under a stateless progress
# (stateless registers nothing — every cursor.<name> ref fails).

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
stdout 'cursor field "last_timestamp" is not provided by the active pagination/progress strategy'

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"
auth:
  none: {}
requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/events
    query:
      since: {ref: cursor.last_timestamp}
response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events
pagination:
  none: {}
progress:
  stateless: {}
